name: Chai SSSP with double-buffered work queues
description: Single-source shortest paths draining a frontier through per-block shared-memory local queues with overflow spill, atomicMax min-relaxation over negated costs, and double-buffered global queues.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: SSSP_gpu kernel + common.h constants/types verbatim; host driver keeps upstream structure (host first iteration, parity queue swap, per-iteration scalar uploads) but is GPU-only over a deterministic CSR graph. Snapshot graph-02.
notes: Real-extraction worklist case from collection snapshot graph-02 - the only worklist-pattern case in the dataset. Dijkstra oracle; converged costs are execution-order independent.
